extension.description: Create, compare and restore simple local project checkpoints without changing normal Git history.
view.name: Checkpoints
view.welcome: No checkpoints have been created yet.\n[Create checkpoint](command:hackschuleCheckpoints.create)
configuration.title: Hackschule Checkpoints
configuration.showStatusBar: Show the checkpoint button in the status bar.
configuration.warnAddedBytes: Warn when a new checkpoint contains at least this many added or changed bytes. Set to 0 to disable this threshold.
configuration.warnChangedFiles: Warn when a new checkpoint changes at least this many files. Set to 0 to disable this threshold.
configuration.warnSingleFileBytes: Warn when one added or changed file is at least this large. Set to 0 to disable this threshold.
